
=== WebPanel: DB.StatementOfIncomeWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_StatementOfIncomeCuenta = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'statementofincomeview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Statement Of Income'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	StatementOfIncomeCuenta.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	StatementOfIncomeSum.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	StatementOfIncomeSubstract.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'StatementOfIncomeCuenta'
					&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'StatementOfIncomeSum'
					&TFStatementOfIncomeSum = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'StatementOfIncomeSubstract'
					&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = StatementOfIncome.Link(TrnMode.Update, StatementOfIncomeCuenta)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.StatementOfIncome.Link(TrnMode.Delete, StatementOfIncomeCuenta)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_StatementOfIncomeCuenta)
		StatementOfIncomeCuenta.Link = DB.StatementOfIncomeView.Link(StatementOfIncomeCuenta, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				WWPBaseObjects.SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		StatementOfIncome.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(StatementOfIncomeCuenta))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'StatementOfIncome', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Transaction: DB.StatementOfIncome ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		StatementOfIncomeWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&StatementOfIncomeCuenta);

StatementOfIncomeCuenta = &StatementOfIncomeCuenta if not &StatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty();
noaccept(StatementOfIncomeCuenta) if not &StatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty();
noprompt(StatementOfIncomeCuenta);

}

LoadAuditStatementOfIncome.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditStatementOfIncome.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditStatementOfIncome.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditStatementOfIncome.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.StatementOfIncomeView ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = StatementOfIncomeWW.Link()
	For each StatementOfIncome
		where StatementOfIncomeCuenta = &StatementOfIncomeCuenta
		Form.Caption = StatementOfIncomeCuenta.ToString()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	If (&Exists)
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif
	&RecordDescription = Form.Caption
	If &Session.Get(!'DiscussionThreadIdToOpen') <> ''
		ddc_Discussions.Open()
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If Not WWP_HasDiscussionMessages(!'StatementOfIncome', StatementOfIncomeCuenta)
		ddc_Discussions.Icon = "far fa-comment"
	EndIf
	If (WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(!'StatementOfIncome', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord))
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = True
	Else
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = False
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'StatementOfIncome', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord, StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &RecordDescription)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Discussions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_DiscussionsWC.Create(!'StatementOfIncome', StatementOfIncomeCuenta, &RecordDescription, DB.StatementOfIncomeView.Link(StatementOfIncomeCuenta, ''))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: DB.StatementOfIncomeWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"StatementOfIncomeWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Cuenta")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Cuenta")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Sum")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeSum.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Sum")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeSum)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Substract")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Statement Income Substract")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each StatementOfIncome
		order StatementOfIncomeCuenta  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeCuenta)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order StatementOfIncomeSum  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeSum)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order StatementOfIncomeSubstract  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeSubstract)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'StatementOfIncomeCuenta'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(StatementOfIncomeCuenta)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'StatementOfIncomeSum'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(StatementOfIncomeSum)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'StatementOfIncomeSubstract'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(StatementOfIncomeSubstract)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"StatementOfIncomeCuenta", '', !'Statement Income Cuenta', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"StatementOfIncomeSum", '', !'Statement Income Sum', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"StatementOfIncomeSubstract", '', !'Statement Income Substract', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'DB.StatementOfIncomeWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(out:&Filename, out:&ErrorMessage);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.StatementOfIncomeWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'statementofincomeww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Statement Of Income List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeCuenta
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFStatementOfIncomeSum.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeSum
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each StatementOfIncome
		order StatementOfIncomeCuenta  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeCuenta)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order StatementOfIncomeSum  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeSum)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order StatementOfIncomeSubstract  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (StatementOfIncomeSubstract)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeCuentaOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMESUM'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSumOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSubstractOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeCuentaOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeCuenta
		using DB.StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		Option Distinct
		If not StatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeCuenta
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSumOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeSum = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeSum
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each StatementOfIncome
			Order StatementOfIncomeSum
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not StatementOfIncomeSum.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeSum
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSubstractOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeSubstract
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.StatementOfIncome
			Order StatementOfIncomeSubstract
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not StatementOfIncomeSubstract.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeSubstract
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditStatementOfIncome ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each StatementOfIncome
		Where StatementOfIncomeCuenta = &StatementOfIncomeCuenta
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'StatementOfIncome'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeCuenta'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Cuenta'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = StatementOfIncomeCuenta.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSum'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Sum'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = StatementOfIncomeSum.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSubstract'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Substract'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = StatementOfIncomeSubstract.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each StatementOfIncome
		Where StatementOfIncomeCuenta = &StatementOfIncomeCuenta
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'StatementOfIncome'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeCuenta'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Cuenta'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeCuenta.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSum'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Sum'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeSum.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSubstract'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Statement Income Substract'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeSubstract.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeCuenta'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeCuenta.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSum'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeSum.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'StatementOfIncomeSubstract'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = StatementOfIncomeSubstract.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &StatementOfIncomeCuenta, in:&ActualMode);
